description: Fixes regular videos and Shorts failing to load on YouTube 21.37.42 and the app crash when swiping to the next Short. The Yandex VoT media transport now derives DataSpec fields and header/cache-key registers dynamically instead of relying on obsolete obfuscated names and p6/p11. Compatibility with earlier YouTube builds is retained. Regression tests, GitHub PR CI, post-merge CI, and the release workflow passed; runtime behavior was confirmed on an Android device with YouTube 21.37.42.
